alt: 兩個孩子躲在架子後窺看棋盤，一人握著多餘棋子，另一人悄悄伸手，等別人不注意時準備作弊。
scene_prompt: 蠢蠢欲動 means restless schemers waiting for a chance to cause trouble, NOT eagerness to do a good deed. Modern neighborhood tabletop game club. Two mischievous older children crouch just behind a shelf with sly restless expressions, peeking around its edge at an unattended board-game table. One holds concealed extra game tokens in one clearly visible hand, the other reaches cautiously toward the board while glancing to see if the honest players have turned away. The action is poised BEFORE cheating, planning to meddle, not already succeeding. Honest players appear small in background fetching water, unaware. Clearly original generic game board with simple colored spaces and wooden tokens, no branded recognizable game, writing or numbers. Four children total, each exactly two arms and legs; foreground pair's hands separate and correct. No weapons, theft of money, unsafe climbing or injury. Gentle cautionary humor, wrongdoing not celebrated. Focus on waiting sneakily for opportunity to disrupt.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D, or imitation of a named artist.
